{{verse|chapter=2|verse=22}} Ye men of I{{ls}}raël heare the{{ls}}e vvordes, {{sc|Iesvs}} of Nazareth a man approued of God among you, by miracles and vvonders and {{ls}}ignes vvhich God did by him in the middes of you, as you knovv: {{verse|chapter=2|verse=23}} this {{ls}}ame, {{sup|‖}} by the determinate coun{{ls}}el and pre{{ls}}cience of God being deliuered, you by the handes of vvicked men haue crucified and {{ls}}laine. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=24}} vvhom God hath rai{{ls}}ed vp {{sup|‖}} loo{{ls}}ing the {{ls}}orovves of hel, according as it vvas impo{{ls}}{{ls}}ible that he {{ls}}hould be holden of it. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=25}} For Dauid {{ls}}aith concerning him, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''P{{ls}}. 15, 8.''}}* ''I fore{{ls}}avv the Lord in my {{ls}}ight alvvaies: becau{{ls}}e he is at my right hand that I be not moued''. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=26}} ''For this, my hart hath been glad and my tongue hath reioyced: moreouer my fle{{ls}}h al{{ls}}o {{ls}}hal re{{ls}}t in hope''. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=27}} {{sup|‖}} ''becau{{ls}}e thou vvilt not leaue my {{ls}}oul '' {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ who but an infidel ({{ls}}aith S. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=33}} Being exalted therfore by the right hand of God, and hauing receiued of his father the promi{{ls}}{{ls}}e of the Holy Gho{{ls}}t, he hath povvred out {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''`this gift vvhich''}}`this vvhom' you {{ls}}ee and heare. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=34}} For Dauid a{{ls}}cended not into heauen: but he {{ls}}aith, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''P{{ls}}. 109, 1.''}}* ''Our Lord hath {{ls}}aid to my Lord, {{ls}}it on my right hand'', {{verse|chapter=2|verse=35}} ''vntil I make thine enemies the foote{{ls}}toole of thy feete''. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=36}} Therfore let al the hou{{ls}}e of I{{ls}}raël know mo{{ls}}t certainly that God hath made him both Lord, and {{sc|Christ}}, this {{sc|Iesvs}}, vvhom you haue crucified.
